name.text: NEET_UG_BIOLOGY_MORPHOLOGY_OF_FLOWERING_PLANTS_ASSERTION_REASON_Q01 - Absorption of water in root maturation zone

questiontext.text:
Assertion (A): The region of maturation in the root is the primary zone responsible for the absorption of water and mineral nutrients from the soil.

Reason (R): Epidermal cells in the region of maturation form very fine, delicate, thread-like structures called root hairs that absorb water and minerals.

अभिकथन (A): मूल का परिपक्वन क्षेत्र मिट्टी से जल और खनिज पोषकों के अवशोषण के लिए मुख्य रूप से उत्तरदायी क्षेत्र है।

कारण (R): परिपक्वन क्षेत्र की बाह्यत्वचीय कोशिकाएं अत्यंत महीन और कोमल धागेनुमा संरचनाएं बनाती हैं जिन्हें मूलरोम कहते हैं, जो जल और खनिजों का अवशोषण करते हैं।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Principle of Root Zonation
The root apex is organized into distinct functional zones: the root cap, the region of meristematic activity, the region of elongation, and the region of maturation.

Step 2: Evaluation of Statements
The statement regarding the region of maturation being the primary site of water and mineral uptake is scientifically correct. The second statement is also correct because the differentiation of epidermal cells into root hairs occurs specifically in this maturation zone, providing the cellular mechanism for absorption.

Step 3: Causal Relationship
Because root hairs develop exclusively from the epidermal cells of the maturation zone and serve as the specialized absorptive structures, the reason directly explains why this zone carries out absorption.

Final Answer:
Both the assertion and the reason are factually correct, and the reason provides the direct explanation for the assertion.

चरण 1: मूल क्षेत्रीयकरण का सिद्धांत
मूल शीर्ष विशिष्ट कार्यात्मक क्षेत्रों में संगठित होता है: मूल गोप, विभज्योतकी सक्रियता का क्षेत्र, दीर्घीकरण क्षेत्र, और परिपक्वन क्षेत्र।

चरण 2: कथनों का मूल्यांकन
परिपक्वन क्षेत्र के जल और खनिज अवशोषण का मुख्य स्थल होने संबंधी कथन वैज्ञानिक रूप से सही है। दूसरा कथन भी सही है क्योंकि बाह्यत्वचीय कोशिकाओं का मूलरोमों में विभेदन इसी परिपक्वन क्षेत्र में होता है।

चरण 3: कारण-प्रभाव संबंध
चूँकि मूलरोम केवल परिपक्वन क्षेत्र की बाह्यत्वचीय कोशिकाओं से विकसित होकर अवशोषण का कार्य करते हैं, इसलिए कारण सीधे स्पष्ट करता है कि यह क्षेत्र अवशोषण क्यों करता है।

अंतिम उत्तर:
अभिकथन और कारण दोनों सही हैं, तथा कारण अभिकथन की सही व्याख्या करता है।

name.text: NEET_UG_BIOLOGY_MORPHOLOGY_OF_FLOWERING_PLANTS_ASSERTION_REASON_Q02 - Pulvinus leaf base and root cap protection

questiontext.text:
Assertion (A): In some leguminous plants, the leaf base becomes swollen to form a specialized structure called the pulvinus.

Reason (R): The apex of the root is protected by a thimble-like structure known as the root cap as it penetrates the soil.

अभिकथन (A): कुछ लेग्यूमिनोसी पादपों में पर्णाधार फूलकर पर्णवृंततल्प (पल्विनस) नामक विशिष्ट संरचना बनाता है।

कारण (R): मिट्टी में प्रवेश करते समय मूल का शीर्ष अंगुलित्रा जैसी संरचना मूल गोप द्वारा सुरक्षित रहता है।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Morphological Principles
In leguminous plants, the leaf base often swells into a pulvinus. Concurrently, in root anatomy, the delicate meristematic apex is capped by a thimble-like root cap.

Step 2: Evaluation of Statements
The statement describing the swollen leaf base (pulvinus) in legumes is factually correct. The statement describing the protective root cap at the root apex is also factually correct.

Step 3: Causal Relationship
The structure and function of the root cap in the root system have no developmental or functional relation to the presence of a pulvinus on the leaf base. Thus, the second statement does not explain the first.

Final Answer:
Both statements are correct, but the reason is not the explanation of the assertion.

चरण 1: आकारिकीय सिद्धांत

चरण 2: कथनों का मूल्यांकन

चरण 3: कारण-प्रभाव संबंध
मूल तंत्र में मूल गोप की संरचना और कार्य का पत्ती के पर्णाधार पर पल्विनस की उपस्थिति से कोई संबंध नहीं है। अतः दूसरा कथन पहले कथन की व्याख्या नहीं करता।

name.text: NEET_UG_BIOLOGY_MORPHOLOGY_OF_FLOWERING_PLANTS_ASSERTION_REASON_Q03 - Growth determination in cymose floral axis

questiontext.text:
Assertion (A): In a cymose inflorescence, the growth of the main floral axis is strictly limited.

Reason (R): The flowers in a cymose inflorescence are always borne laterally in an acropetal succession on an endlessly elongating axis.

अभिकथन (A): ससीमाक्षी पुष्पक्रम में मुख्य पुष्पीय अक्ष की वृद्धि सीमित होती है।

कारण (R): ससीमाक्षी पुष्पक्रम में पुष्प निरंतर लंबे होते अक्ष पर सदैव अग्राभिसारी क्रम में पार्श्व रूप से लगते हैं।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Inflorescence Growth Characteristics
Inflorescences are categorized into racemose and cymose types based on the developmental fate of the shoot apical meristem.

Step 2: Evaluation of Statements
The first statement is correct because in a cymose inflorescence, the main axis terminates in a flower, thereby terminating indeterminate elongation. The second statement is incorrect because flowers in a cymose inflorescence are borne in a basipetal order, whereas acropetal succession on an elongated axis is the defining feature of racemose inflorescences.

Final Answer:
The assertion is correct, but the reason is incorrect.

चरण 1: पुष्पक्रम वृद्धि के लक्षण
प्ररोह शीर्षस्थ विभज्योतक के भविष्य के आधार पर पुष्पक्रम को असीमाक्षी और ससीमाक्षी में वर्गीकृत किया जाता है।

चरण 2: कथनों का मूल्यांकन
पहला कथन सही है क्योंकि ससीमाक्षी पुष्पक्रम में मुख्य अक्ष पुष्प में समाप्त हो जाता है, जिससे वृद्धि सीमित हो जाती है। दूसरा कथन गलत है क्योंकि ससीमाक्षी पुष्पक्रम में पुष्प तलाभिसारी क्रम में लगते हैं, जबकि अग्राभिसारी क्रम असीमाक्षी पुष्पक्रम का लक्षण है।

अंतिम उत्तर:
अभिकथन सही है, लेकिन कारण गलत है।

name.text: NEET_UG_BIOLOGY_MORPHOLOGY_OF_FLOWERING_PLANTS_ASSERTION_REASON_Q04 - Inferior ovary condition in epigynous flowers

questiontext.text:
Assertion (A): Flowers of guava and cucumber possess an inferior ovary.

Reason (R): In epigynous flowers, the margin of the thalamus grows upward enclosing the ovary completely and getting fused with it, so the other floral parts arise above the ovary.

अभिकथन (A): अमरूद और खीरे के पुष्पों में अधोवर्ती अंडाशय पाया जाता है।

कारण (R): अधिजायांगी पुष्पों में पुष्पासन का किनारा ऊपर की ओर बढ़कर अंडाशय को पूरी तरह घेर लेता है और उसके साथ संलयित हो जाता है, जिससे अन्य पुष्पीय भाग अंडाशय के ऊपर से निकलते हैं।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Classification of Ovary Position
Depending on the position of the calyx, corolla, and androecium with respect to the ovary on the thalamus, flowers are described as hypogynous, perigynous, or epigynous.

Step 2: Evaluation of Statements
Guava and cucumber produce epigynous flowers where the ovary is situated below the other floral organs, making the ovary inferior. The reason accurately defines the anatomical mechanism: the hollow thalamus encloses and fuses with the ovary, positioning sepals, petals, and stamens above it.

Step 3: Causal Relationship
Because the thalamus margin completely engulfs and fuses with the ovary causing all other floral whorls to emerge from above it, the ovary is classified as inferior.

Final Answer:
Both the assertion and the reason are correct, and the reason correctly explains the assertion.

name.text: NEET_UG_BIOLOGY_MORPHOLOGY_OF_FLOWERING_PLANTS_ASSERTION_REASON_Q05 - Phyllotaxy patterns in Alstonia and Calotropis

questiontext.text:
Assertion (A): Alstonia is characterized by whorled phyllotaxy.

Reason (R): In Calotropis and guava, a pair of leaves arises at each node and lies opposite to each other.

अभिकथन (A): एल्सटोनिया में चक्करदार पर्णविन्यास पाया जाता है।

कारण (R): कैलोट्रोपिस और अमरूद में प्रत्येक पर्वसंधि पर एक जोड़ी पत्तियाँ निकलती हैं और एक-दूसरे के सम्मुख स्थित होती हैं।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Phyllotaxy Patterns
Phyllotaxy is the pattern of leaf arrangement on the stem, categorized as alternate, opposite, or whorled.

Step 2: Evaluation of Statements
In Alstonia, more than two leaves arise at each node to form a whorl, making the assertion correct. In Calotropis and guava, exactly two leaves develop at each node opposite one another, making the reason factually correct.

Step 3: Causal Relationship
The opposite phyllotaxy observed in Calotropis and guava is an independent botanical fact that does not provide any explanatory cause for the whorled arrangement in Alstonia.

Final Answer:
Both statements are correct, but the reason is not the correct explanation of the assertion.

name.text: NEET_UG_BIOLOGY_MORPHOLOGY_OF_FLOWERING_PLANTS_ASSERTION_REASON_Q06 - Dicotyledonous leaf venation and network formation

questiontext.text:
Assertion (A): Leaves of dicotyledonous plants generally possess reticulate venation.

Reason (R): In reticulate venation, the veins within the lamina run parallel to each other without forming any network or veinlets.

अभिकथन (A): द्विबीजपत्री पादपों की पत्तियों में सामान्यतः जालिकावत् शिराविन्यास पाया जाता है।

कारण (R): जालिकावत् शिराविन्यास में पर्णफलक के भीतर शिराएं बिना कोई जाल या शिराएँ बनाए एक-दूसरे के समानांतर चलती हैं।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Principles of Leaf Venation
Venation refers to the arrangement of veins and veinlets in the lamina: reticulate when veinlets form an interconnected network, and parallel when veins run parallel within the lamina.

Step 2: Evaluation of Statements
The assertion is correct because dicot leaves characteristically display reticulate venation. The reason is incorrect because parallel arrangement without a network defines parallel venation (typical of monocots), whereas reticulate venation forms an intricate network of veinlets.

Final Answer:
The assertion is correct, but the reason is incorrect.

name.text: NEET_UG_BIOLOGY_MORPHOLOGY_OF_FLOWERING_PLANTS_ASSERTION_REASON_Q07 - False septum formation in mustard ovary

questiontext.text:
Assertion (A): The ovary in mustard and Argemone is one-chambered initially, but becomes two-chambered in the mature state.

Reason (R): A false septum forms across the ovarian cavity in mustard and Argemone, dividing the single locule into two chambers.

अभिकथन (A): सरसों और आर्जिमोन में अंडाशय प्रारंभ में एककोष्ठीय होता है, किंतु परिपक्व अवस्था में द्विकोष्ठीय बन जाता है।

कारण (R): सरसों और आर्जिमोन में अंडाशय गुहा के आर-पार एक कूटपट (फाल्स सेप्टम) बनता है, जो एकल कोष्ठ को दो कक्षों में विभाजित कर देता है।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Parietal Placentation Anatomy
In parietal placentation, ovules develop on the inner wall or peripheral part of a unilocular ovary.

Step 2: Evaluation of Statements
The assertion is correct because in mustard and Argemone, the ovary starts as a single chamber but develops two distinct chambers. The reason is also correct because this bi-locular appearance is caused by the secondary formation of a false septum (replum).

Step 3: Causal Relationship
The formation of the false septum directly accounts for why an initially unilocular ovary becomes two-chambered.

Final Answer:
Both the assertion and the reason are correct, and the reason is the correct explanation of the assertion.

name.text: NEET_UG_BIOLOGY_MORPHOLOGY_OF_FLOWERING_PLANTS_ASSERTION_REASON_Q08 - Drupe pericarp in coconut and mango

questiontext.text:
Assertion (A): In the coconut fruit, the mesocarp layer of the pericarp is fibrous.

Reason (R): Mango and coconut fruits are drupes that develop from monocarpellary superior ovaries and are one-seeded.

अभिकथन (A): नारियल के फल में फलभित्ति की मध्यफलभित्ति परत रेशेदार होती है।

कारण (R): आम और नारियल के फल अष्ठिल (ड्रूप) हैं जो एकअंडपी ऊर्ध्ववर्ती अंडाशय से विकसित होते हैं और एकबीजीय होते हैं।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Pericarp Differentiation in Drupes
A drupe is a simple fruit with a three-layered pericarp: epicarp, mesocarp, and stony endocarp.

Step 2: Evaluation of Statements
The assertion is correct because the mesocarp of coconut forms fibrous coir. The reason is also factually correct because both mango and coconut develop from monocarpellary superior ovaries and produce a single seed inside a hard endocarp.

Step 3: Causal Relationship
The morphological definition and origin of a drupe from a monocarpellary superior ovary explains its classification as a drupe, but does not explain why coconut specifically develops a fibrous mesocarp rather than a fleshy one.

Final Answer:
Both statements are correct, but the reason is not the correct explanation of the assertion.

name.text: NEET_UG_BIOLOGY_MORPHOLOGY_OF_FLOWERING_PLANTS_ASSERTION_REASON_Q09 - Shoot apical meristem condensation into flower

questiontext.text:
Assertion (A): A flower is developmentally and morphologically regarded as a modified shoot meant for sexual reproduction.

Reason (R): During floral transformation, the internodes of the shoot axis undergo rapid elongation to space out floral appendages at distant intervals.

अभिकथन (A): पुष्प को विकासात्मक और आकारिकीय रूप से लैंगिक जनन हेतु रूपांतरित प्ररोह माना जाता है।

कारण (R): पुष्पीय रूपांतरण के दौरान प्ररोह अक्ष के पर्व तेजी से लंबे हो जाते हैं ताकि पुष्पीय उपांगों को दूर-दूर फैलाया जा सके।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Morphological Nature of Flower
A flower is a determinate shoot wherein the shoot apical meristem transforms into a floral meristem.

Step 2: Evaluation of Statements
The assertion is correct because the flower represents a modified shoot bearing modified floral appendages at successive nodes. The reason is incorrect because during flower development, the internodes do not elongate at all; rather, the axis condenses so that floral appendages arise in close successive whorls on the thalamus.

Final Answer:
The assertion is correct, but the reason is incorrect.

name.text: NEET_UG_BIOLOGY_MORPHOLOGY_OF_FLOWERING_PLANTS_ASSERTION_REASON_Q10 - Axillary buds in simple and compound leaves

questiontext.text:
Assertion (A): In a pinnately compound leaf, a vegetative axillary bud is present in the axil of each individual leaflet along the rachis.

Reason (R): A bud is present in the axil of the petiole in both simple and compound leaves, but never in the axil of leaflets of a compound leaf.

अभिकथन (A): पिच्छाकार संयुक्त पत्ती में रैचिस पर स्थित प्रत्येक व्यक्तिगत पर्णक के कक्ष में एक कायिक कक्षीय कलिका उपस्थित होती है।

कारण (R): सरल और संयुक्त दोनों प्रकार की पत्तियों में पर्णवृंत के कक्ष में कलिका उपस्थित होती है, किंतु संयुक्त पत्ती के पर्णकों के कक्ष में कभी कलिका नहीं होती।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Leaf and Leaflet Distinctions
Botanical identification distinguishes whole leaves from leaflets by the specific placement of axillary buds.

Step 2: Evaluation of Statements
The assertion is incorrect because leaflets never possess axillary buds in their axils; their presence would indicate a stem bearing leaves rather than a single compound leaf. The reason is factually correct because axillary buds occur exclusively in the axil of the main petiole of both simple and compound leaves.

Final Answer:
The assertion is incorrect, but the reason is correct.

name.text: NEET_UG_BIOLOGY_MORPHOLOGY_OF_FLOWERING_PLANTS_ASSERTION_REASON_Q12 - Protective sheaths in monocot maize embryo

questiontext.text:
Assertion (A): In a germinating maize seed, the shoot apex (plumule) is enclosed by a protective sheath called the coleorhiza, while the root apex (radicle) is enclosed by the coleoptile.

Reason (R): In monocotyledonous seeds such as maize, the plumule is enclosed in a sheath called the coleoptile, and the radicle is enclosed in a sheath called the coleorhiza.

अभिकथन (A): मक्का के बीज में प्ररोह शीर्ष (प्रांकुर) मूलांकुर चोल (कोलियोराइज) नामक आवरण से ढका होता है, जबकि मूल शीर्ष (मूलांकुर) प्रांकुर चोल (कोलियोप्टाइल) द्वारा ढका होता है।

कारण (R): मक्का जैसे एकबीजपत्री बीजों में प्रांकुर, प्रांकुर चोल (कोलियोप्टाइल) में बंद होता है तथा मूलांकुर, मूलांकुर चोल (कोलियोराइज) में बंद होता है।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Embryo Structure of Monocotyledonous Seeds
Cereal grains possess an embryonal axis with specialized protective sheaths enclosing each developmental pole.

Step 2: Evaluation of Statements
The assertion is incorrect because it reverses the developmental sheaths: the plumule is covered by the coleoptile, not coleorhiza, and the radicle is covered by the coleorhiza, not coleoptile. The reason is completely accurate according to monocot morphology.

Final Answer:
The assertion is incorrect, but the reason is correct.
